summary: Completed full e2e testing of Voice-First Repair Assistant Step 2. All backend APIs working (20/20 tests passed). Frontend loads correctly with dark theme, all UI elements verified. New features: session CRUD, manual system, WebSocket session.ready with session_id.

issues: Console warning about <span> inside <option> - React dev tools instrumentation, not actual code issue (same as previous iterations)

critical_code_review_comments: Code quality is good - proper async/await usage, SQLite with aiosqlite for async DB operations
Manual seeding works correctly - both Stihl FS 56 RC and Dyson V15 manuals are loaded
WebSocket protocol correctly returns session.ready with session_id after config message
Session state includes all required fields: turns, observations, tool_runs, manual-related fields
seed_data_creation: 2 manuals seeded automatically on startup: stihl-fs56rc (Stihl FS 56 RC String Trimmer), dyson-v15 (Dyson V15 Detect Cordless Vacuum)
context_for_next_testing_agent: All Step 2 features tested: GET /api/health (returns version 2.0-step2), GET /api/personas (4 personas), GET /api/voices (5 voices), POST /api/sessions (creates session with id + status=active), GET /api/sessions/{id}/state (returns full state with turns, observations, tool_runs), POST /api/sessions/{id}/end (ends session), GET /api/sessions/{id}/logs (returns turns and tool_runs), WebSocket /api/ws/session (returns session.ready with session_id after config). Frontend /repair page verified: dark theme, 'Voice + Vision Repair' title, 'Gemini Live' badge, persona dropdown (4 options), voice dropdown (5 options), Start Session button, status 'Ready'. Camera and mic require browser permissions - cannot test in headless. Tool calling (lookup_manual) requires actual Gemini session.
